title: Etale triple algebras map flatly to the strict henselization completion
statement: Let R be a Noetherian local commutative ring with maximal ideal m, let K be a separable closure of its residue field, and let C=R^{\mathrm{sh}} be the strict henselization defined as the filtered colimit of pointed etale R-algebras with residue embeddings into K [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. For every triple (S,q,phi) in this filtered triple category, the canonical map S\to\widehat C=\varprojlim_n C/(mC)^n induced by S\to C is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ (lemma-henselization-noetherian), proof part (c), paragraph beginning 'To finish the proof of (c)'

proof.text: Transport the separable closure from the scheme residue field to R/m_R using the residue-field map of stalkClosedPointIso. The residue-field map commutes with evaluation, so the structural R-map to K is exactly the prescribed composite. Apply the proved colimit comparison [lem-sc-etale-triples-colimit-is-strict-henselization] with c.pt given the algebra structure rho. It yields IsStrictHenselization R K c.pt.

The maximal-ideal completion of the strict henselization is flat over R by the existing strict-henselization completion theorem. The displayed map is flat over t.B because t.B is etale, hence formally unramified and essentially of finite type, so flatness descends by Algebra.FormallyUnramified.flat_of_restrictScalars.
